epav.ambiguous_sample_policy: source-column technical IDs, both excluded from measured phenotype joins
epav.feature_identity: all 2000 old shifted binary vectors uniquely matched to source full records, including source metadata, at >=1 threshold
epav.type: expression presence; NOT genomic gene presence/absence; NOT published confidence-interval definition
epav.selection: original 2000 selected positions recovered, selection process unknown; not claimed phenotype-blind original feature sampling
epav.phenotype: S6 Last Juvenile Leaf; 2010/2011 field observations summarized by authors; exact ID with S1 accession only

sv.phenotype_source: same-paper Supplementary Table S1, Seedling SR (%) column N; Genotype column A; genetic origin P
sv.vcf_reference: B73v5, source VCF contig lengths retained

validation_scope: 5-fold prediction within each original cohort; no cross-cohort concatenation; not breeding efficacy or unbiased feature selection performance proof
